title: The 'find and join your gym online' set-up step says joiners pay at the desk and that paying online needs Razorpay or Cashfree, while live online joining already takes payment to the gym's UPI ID
what: The 'How people pay' part of the set-up step always says people who ask to join online pay at the desk on their first visit. When online join payment is switched on it adds that the owner must connect Razorpay or Cashfree first. The live join page takes payment straight to the gym's own UPI ID with no payment company at all, and a company link is not even offered until company payments go live.
expected: The step says the same thing the join page does: with a UPI ID saved and 'Take payments when people join online' switched on, joiners pay to the gym's UPI ID when they join, and the desk confirms on Today.
how_often: every time an owner opens this set-up step
fix_line: Rewrite the pay part to follow what the join page offers: UPI ID plus the owner's switch, company link only once live

title: A changed gym UPI ID can take a long time to reach the join page and the members' shop QR
what: When the owner saves a new UPI ID in Settings, it is kept in the gym's records. The join page and the shop read a second copy that is only refreshed when the owner (never the desk) next opens a money screen, and not at all if that screen already asked in the last minute. Until then people joining online are shown the old UPI ID to pay to.
expected: Saving a new UPI ID updates the copy the join page uses at the same moment, or the join page reads the gym's own record.
how_often: after every UPI ID change, until the owner next opens a money screen
fix_line: Send the new UPI ID to the payment server when gym details are saved, with a forced refresh
